# Hepatitis: a normal hierarchical model with measurement error (basic)
# Generated from JuliaBUGS.BUGSExamples.VOLUME_3.hepatitis
using JuliaBUGS

model_def = JuliaBUGS.@bugs("""
model
{
    for( i in 1 : N ) {
        for( j in 1 : T ) {
            Y[i , j] ~ dnorm(mu[i , j],tau)
            mu[i , j] <- alpha[i] + beta[i] * (t[i,j] - 6.5) + gamma * (y0[i] - mean(y0[]))
        }
        alpha[i] ~ dnorm(alpha0,tau.alpha)
        beta[i] ~ dnorm(beta0,tau.beta)
    }
    tau ~ dgamma(0.001,0.001)
    sigma <- 1 / sqrt(tau)
    alpha0 ~ dnorm(0.0,1.0E-6) 
    tau.alpha ~ dgamma(0.001,0.001)
    beta0 ~ dnorm(0.0,1.0E-6)
    tau.beta ~ dgamma(0.001,0.001)
    gamma ~ dnorm(0.0,1.0E-6)
}
""", false)

build_model(data, inits = (;)) = JuliaBUGS.compile(model_def, data, inits)
